sloka: सो अवतीर्य रथात् शीघ्रम् राज वेश्म प्रविश्य च ।कक्ष्याः सप्त अभिचक्राम महा जन समाकुलाः ॥२-५७-१७॥
transliteration: so avatīrya rathāt śīghram rāja veśma praviśya ca ।kakṣyāḥ sapta abhicakrāma mahā jana samākulāḥ ॥2-57-17॥

translations.english: Quickly alighting from the chariot, he entered the king's palace and crossed the seven courtyards overcrowded with people.
